VAMPIRISM.name: Vampirism
VAMPIRISM.describe: Below 50% HP, its lifesteal is doubled.

VIGOR.name: Second Wind
VIGOR.describe: The first time its HP drops below 50% (even on a hit that would normally be fatal, which is then cancelled), it recovers {{value}}% of its max HP.

HASTE.name: Haste
HASTE.describe: Every 3 actions, it acts again immediately.

FORTIFY.name: Fortification
FORTIFY.describe: Each hit taken grants +{{value}}% DEF, stacking up to 5 times.

EMPOWER.name: Empowerment
EMPOWER.describe: Each attack landed grants +{{value}}% ATK, stacking up to 5 times.

BULWARK.name: Bulwark
BULWARK.describe: Absorbs a shield worth {{value}}% of max HP.

CRIT.name: Precision
CRIT.describe: Every 3 attacks, deals a guaranteed critical hit.

PIERCE.name: Armor Piercer
PIERCE.describe: The first hit on each target ignores all of its defense.

REGEN.name: Regeneration
REGEN.describe: Heals {{value}}% of max HP at the end of the turn.

BLESSING.name: Blessing
BLESSING.describe: Heals the weakest ally for {{value}}% of their max HP at the end of the turn.

SANCTUARY.name: Sanctuary
SANCTUARY.describe: Heals the whole team for {{value}}% of max HP at the end of the turn.

BURN.name: Burn
BURN.describe: Inflicts a burn: {{value}}% of ATK per turn for 2 turns.

POISON.name: Poison
POISON.describe: Poisons the target: {{value}}% of its max HP per turn for 2 turns.

BLOODLUST.name: Bloodlust
BLOODLUST.describe: Heals for {{value}}% of max HP when finishing off an enemy.
